Private wb As Object

Public Sub Setup()
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
End Sub

Public Sub Reopen(ByVal folder As String)
    Dim path As String
    path = folder & Application.PathSeparator & "methods.xlsx"
    wb.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
End Sub

Public Sub Finish()
    wb.Close False
End Sub

Private Function Show(v As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(v) Then
        Show = "Null"
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Show = "Empty"
    ElseIf Len(CStr(v)) > 40 Then
        Show = TypeName(v) & " " & Len(CStr(v))
    Else
        Show = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function R0(ws As Object) As String
    Dim s As String, v As Variant

    v = Empty

    v = Empty
    v = ws.Rows(4).Hidden
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then

    v = Empty

Public Function S0() As String
    Dim ws As Object, o As Object, r As Variant, e As Long
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=wb.Worksheets(wb.Worksheets.Count))
    ws.Range("B2:C2").Value = Array("h1", "h2"): ws.Range("B3:C3").Value = Array(3, "c"): ws.Range("B4:C4").Value = Array(1, "a"): ws.Range("B5:C5").Value = Array(2, "b")
